AdGuard Home v0.107.79 for Windows (64-bit)
==========================================

This folder is an unmodified copy of AdGuard Home, taken from the
AdGuard Team's official release. PNet did not write this program.

  Project:  AdGuard Home
  Authors:  AdGuard Team / AdGuard Software Limited
  Version:  v0.107.79 (published 18 August 2026)
  Source:   https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome
  Release:  https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/releases/tag/v0.107.79
  Package:  https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/releases/download/v0.107.79/AdGuardHome_windows_amd64.zip

What each file is
------------------

  AdGuardHome.exe   The official Windows binary from that zip. Not modified.
  LICENSE.txt       GNU General Public License v3, as shipped by AdGuard.
  README.md         AdGuard Home's own readme, as shipped in the zip.
  CHANGELOG.md      AdGuard Home's changelog, as shipped in the zip.
  README.txt        This note, written by PNet.

License
-------

AdGuard Home is free software under the GNU GPL v3. See LICENSE.txt.
The corresponding source is the AdGuard Home repository linked above.

PNet itself is MIT-licensed. PNet starts this program as a separate DNS
server and talks to it on 127.0.0.1:3000. PNet does not merge AdGuard
Home's code into the PNet license.

The ad-blocking domain list PNet can turn on is also AdGuard's, and is
downloaded separately. It is the AdGuard DNS filter:

  https://adguardteam.github.io/AdGuardSDNSFilter/Filters/filter.txt
